blocked comes from the pre-flock tfPre (L170, L390, L773) and is reused inside the lock against the re-read tf (L199, L463, L865; counts at L358/L522/L932). Probe in a mktemp repo: an unbound file whose gate runs `tp set --epic b` (b blocked by c). `tp done t1` closed open t1 and exited 0 with ready:1, has_next:true. A second tp done t2 was refused with blocked_by_epics [c]. Fix: recompute epicBlockedBy(tf) under the lock.

exitIfNextBlocked (L51) and readyBlocked (L79) discard output.JSON's error with `_ =`. readyBlocked then returns true and ready.go:46-47 returns nil, so a failed stdout write on a blocked tp ready exits 0 with no payload. claim.go:206 and done.go:543 handle the same error. Mirrors the older next.go:128/130 pattern, but it is new 1.5.0 code. Fix: return/propagate the error (e.g. readyBlocked returns (bool, error)).
